prompts: Create a single transparent 16-bit isometric city-to-comet-island bridge sprite, top city to bottom corrupted shore, in the pictured water gap. Place a giant upright black-violet void portal at the roadway midpoint, with alien pylons, a clear cyan-violet protective energy shield, and road continuing through the portal. Preserve separate original city-to-Miami and collapsed Miami crossings on the map; no water backdrop, UI, vehicles or clouds in the sprite.

Using the generated bridge as style and shape reference, create only the luminous protective portal shield as an isolated transparent effect: tall faceted cyan-violet arch with electric rim and transparent center, no road, land, portal interior or background.
note: The bridge source contains the portal and a static halo. The independent shield source supplies an additional pulsing effect layer in the browser preview.
